statement: When a pull request resolves an issue, write a closing keyword for it in the body (`Closes #N`, one per issue); a number in the title or a sync line does not close anything. 2026-11-16: #710 named #674 and #653 only in its title and its body was the runner's draft placeholder, so both stayed open five days after the merge, and a later triage of 63 open later: issues against main had to re-derive from code and CHANGELOG that they were fixed. The same triage found a third issue settled by an operator ruling (#453) and two duplicates (#703 of #714, #493 of #480) that no session had closed. Fix: before opening a PR, list every issue it resolves and give each its own closing line; when a ruling or a later PR settles an issue, close it in the same session with a comment citing the commit.
